hook: Shelly the turtle leads five calm-down tools on the big screen: fill a balloon with your breath, trace a star, count a rainbow up and down, stretch, and notice five senses.
outcome: Practice calming strategies (slow breathing, counting, stretching, noticing) and check how your body feels before and after
sources: Illustrations drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
Sounds and calm music generated in the browser
